description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's 'read-tree' command, specifically testing rejection of confusing or problematic path names under different configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the commands in its arguments.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the preceding command fails.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Specifies commands to run after the test completes.
